svg.title: On the command line, screen 4: Per-command help: plain words, usage, examples that always start with a -n preview.

g.text: bond-manager swap-member - replace a bond port with another, with no outage
The tool for moving a live server to a new switch, one cable at a time. It
adds the new port, WAITS until the kernel really uses it, and only then
removes the old one - so the bond is never short a leg.
sudo bond-manager swap-member bond0 --old ens1f0 --new ens2f0
sudo bond-manager swap-member bond0 --old ens1f1 --new ens2f1
- The new port must have a link before you start ('bond-manager nics').
- 802.3ad (LACP) across two separate switches will not aggregate; switch
to active-backup for the move (see: bond-manager help moving).
